bio: Behind this name, referring to a shrub endemic to the Canary Islands, this simple place with a contemporary atmosphere is surprising locals and visitors alike. Ronny Reina, a Colombian trained under the wing of award-winning chef Nandu Jubany, is unashamedly committed to the best local produce, combining the traditional dishes of the islands (such as its wonderful local fish in suquet of Canarian casserole with black potato) with delicious rice dishes a la llauna and other elaborations of a more international character (you will see the classic sirloin Wellington accompanied by Paris coffee sauce, microgreens and soufflé potatoes). The à la carte is supported by two suggestive tasting menus: Retama and Tajinaste!
